units: <cite ref="Berakhot 3b:22">Ber. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>עד חצות … בשירות ות׳</he> until midnight he (David) was engaged in the study of the Law, and henceforward in songs and praises.
<cite ref="Pesachim 117a:8">Pes. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>כל תוש׳ האמורות וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>תש׳</he>) all praises in the Book of Psalms are composed by David.

<cite ref="Megillah 12b:2">Meg. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>שישראל … ובדברי ת׳ וכ׳</he> when the Israelites eat and drink, they begin (their conversations) with words of the Law and words (songs) of praises, but the nations …, with words of frivolity; a. fr.
